generalRule: For Grade 1 Active Grade Abilities, Energy cost is 1 unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy). An Action/Reaction also uses the corresponding Action Point under the battle rules.

aptitudes.name: Cellular Regeneration
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Basic Regeneration
abilities.effect: No início de cada Turn, recupera Energy igual ao Tier.

abilities.name: Cleanse
abilities.effect: Remove um status negativo contínuo, como Bleeding, Blinded, Burned, Corroded ou Poisoned.

aptitudes.name: Cryokinesis
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Frost Stream
abilities.effect: Ranged Attack contra alvo Near usando Precision ou Spirit; acerto causa Elemental damage igual a Tier Die + Spirit; Critical Hit também aplica Slowed.

abilities.name: Glacial Slide
abilities.effect: Cria gelo e desliza 2 Range categories como Move Action; por 1 round, a área é Difficult Terrain para os demais.

abilities.name: Sub-Zero Parry
abilities.effect: Active Block contra arma física; adiciona Resistance à Defense e impõe −2 no próximo Attack roll do atacante.

aptitudes.name: Density Manipulation
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Alloy Compression Strike
abilities.effect: O próximo ataque melee desarmado, incluindo Natural Weapons, causa +1 Tier Die de dano se acertar.

abilities.name: Dense Footing
abilities.effect: Em solo sólido, recebe Advantage em Tests para resistir a shove, arremesso ou condição Prone.

abilities.name: Weightless Feather
abilities.effect: Reduz massa quase a zero até o fim do Turn, fica imune a dano de queda e pode tentar Challenging Agility Test para mover 2 Range categories; sofre Disadvantage contra empurrões, Prone ou ser lançado pelo vento.

aptitudes.name: Duplication
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Coordinated Distraction
abilities.effect: Uma vez por Turn, um clone distrai e concede Advantage ao próximo Attack roll de aliado Close.

abilities.name: Mitotic Split
abilities.effect: Cria duplicata em Close; tem os mesmos stats e Skills e age no Turn do usuário usando os Action Points dele; qualquer dano direto a desfaz. Limite de duas duplicatas neste Grade.

abilities.name: Shared Awareness
abilities.effect: Duplicatas compartilham visão e audição; recebe bônus de Defense igual ao Tier contra ataques de inimigos na mesma Zone de qualquer clone.

aptitudes.name: Energy Blast
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Focused Blast
abilities.effect: Ranged Attack contra alvo Near; em acerto causa Tier Die + Damage Attribute.

abilities.name: Precision Cutter
abilities.effect: Micro-feixe derrete silenciosamente cadeados comuns ou vidro sem Test; segurança militar ou high-tech ainda exige Hack Test.

abilities.name: Recoil Propel
abilities.effect: Active Dodge contra um ataque; adiciona Grade +1 à Defense.

aptitudes.name: Enhanced Agility
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Cat-Like Reflexes
abilities.effect: Recebe +3 Initiative e +2 Defense quando usa Active Dodge.

abilities.name: Surface Wall-Runner
abilities.effect: Corre por paredes, janelas e troncos como parte do movimento normal; escalar não conta como Difficult Terrain.

abilities.name: Tumble Recovery
abilities.effect: Quando ataque ou tremor causaria Prone, recupera-se e permanece de pé.

aptitudes.name: Enhanced Durability
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Brace for Impact
abilities.effect: Quando ataque físico ou balístico acerta, reduz o dano em Resistance + Tier.

abilities.name: Dense Physiology
abilities.effect: Recebe +1 Resistance por Grade.

abilities.name: Unshakable Posture
abilities.effect: Remove Shaken ou ignora knockback de tremor contínuo.

aptitudes.name: Enhanced Senses
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Anti-Concealment Sweep
abilities.effect: Filtra luz e som para localizar ameaça invisível, phased ou camuflada em Near range.

abilities.name: Reflexive Tracking
abilities.effect: Acrescenta Grade +1 à Defense contra um ataque, antecipado por sons sutis e movimento do ar.

abilities.name: Sensory Radar
abilities.effect: Recebe +5 Initiative e Advantage em Mind (Investigation) e Survival Tests quando sentidos aguçados forem relevantes.

aptitudes.name: Exoskeletal Dermis
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Flex Plates
abilities.effect: Duplica DR natural contra o próximo ataque físico recebido neste round.

abilities.name: Deflective Shell
abilities.effect: Adiciona +2 Defense contra incoming ranged fire.

abilities.name: Dense Chitin Plating
abilities.effect: Recebe +2 DR e +1 Resistance por Grade.

aptitudes.name: Extensible Organics
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Elongated Grasp
abilities.effect: Estende o alcance de ataques desarmados e melee para Near por 1 round.

abilities.name: Prehensile Snatch
abilities.effect: Tenta arrancar arma ou item de alvo Near com Opposed Precision ou Agility contra Force ou Agility.

abilities.name: Tensile Physiology
abilities.effect: Pode passar por grades/canos estreitos e recebe +2 DR contra ataques físicos contundentes.

aptitudes.name: Flight
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Aerial Extraction
abilities.effect: Pode carregar aliado ou civil enquanto voa sem custo extra de movimento; sem esta habilidade, só pode voar sozinho.

abilities.name: Aerial Touchdown
abilities.effect: Entrar em batalha vindo do ar adiciona Grade à Initiative.

abilities.name: Tactical Flight
abilities.effect: Advantage em Agility Tests para manobras aéreas enquanto voa.

aptitudes.name: Frictionless Acceleration
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Enhanced Reflexes
abilities.effect: Recebe +5 Initiative e Advantage em Agility Tests para evitar obstáculos ambientais.

abilities.name: Frictionless Defense
abilities.effect: Se mover 2 ou mais Range categories durante o Turn, recebe +2 Defense contra ataques ranged até o próximo Turn.

abilities.name: Sprint Acceleration
abilities.effect: Cobre 2 Range categories com uma única Move Action.

aptitudes.name: Geokinesis
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Seismic Footing
abilities.effect: Em contato com pedra, concreto ou solo, recebe Advantage em Mind Tests para rastrear alvos por vibrações do chão.

abilities.name: Shard Projectile
abilities.effect: Dispara fragmentos em Near range; escolhe Force ou Precision para ataque e dano Physical; Critical Hit deixa alvo Prone.

abilities.name: Tectonic Bastion
abilities.effect: Ergue placa de pedra/cristal para bloquear ataque, adicionando Grade +2 Defense; a placa permanece como cover até fim da Scene.

aptitudes.name: Hyper Leaping
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Heroic Landing
abilities.effect: Ao chegar a uma Scene com salto estiloso, adiciona Grade à Initiative.

abilities.name: Mighty Spring
abilities.effect: Salta 2 Range categories em uma Move Action, ignorando hazards no trajeto, mas não no ponto de chegada.

abilities.name: Vaulting Strike
abilities.effect: Ao impulsionar-se em parede/obstáculo durante movimento, recebe +1 dano no próximo melee attack do Turn.

aptitudes.name: Hyper-Cognition
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Bigger Brain
abilities.effect: Recebe +3 Mind.

abilities.name: Predictive Targeting
abilities.effect: Ataca com blaster ou arma de energia usando Mind em vez de Precision.

abilities.name: Quick Code Hack
abilities.effect: Faz Hack Test com Advantage para contornar fechaduras, câmeras ou sensores eletrônicos.

aptitudes.name: Hyper-Musculature
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Brute Force
abilities.effect: Adiciona Grade ao dano Physical quando acerta.

abilities.name: Heavy Push
abilities.effect: Depois de acertar melee, faz Opposed Force Test contra Force do alvo; em sucesso, empurra 2 Range categories e deixa Prone.

abilities.name: Rescue Strength
abilities.effect: Recebe Advantage em Force Tests em Rescue Scenes para erguer vigas caídas ou sustentar destroços.

aptitudes.name: Molecular Phasing
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Ethereal Step
abilities.effect: Próxima Movement Action ignora Difficult Terrain e hazards no chão.

abilities.name: Phasing
abilities.effect: Atravessa objetos sólidos até o início do próximo Turn; enquanto phased, recebe bônus de Defense e DR igual a Grade +1; não pode fazer ataques físicos exceto com habilidades específicas.

abilities.name: Weightless Drift
abilities.effect: Advantage em testes de equilíbrio e imunidade a dano de queda.

aptitudes.name: Natural Weapons
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Biological Lethality
abilities.effect: Adiciona Grade às attack rolls com Natural Weapons e permite rerrolar resultados 1 nos Damage dice.

abilities.name: Rending Laceration
abilities.effect: Após acertar, faz Opposed Force ou Precision contra Resistance; em sucesso, deixa alvo Bleeding por 1 round.

abilities.name: Unsheathed Ambush
abilities.effect: Revela arma natural durante o golpe e recebe Advantage no primeiro melee strike da Scene.

aptitudes.name: Omni-Tech Arsenal
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Deflector Micro-Mesh
abilities.effect: Adiciona Mind ou Precision +2 à Defense contra um ataque melee ou ranged.

abilities.name: Proto-Tool Modular Configuration
abilities.effect: Alterna entre Energy Blade (melee, Tier Die + Force Energy damage), Plasma Carbine (ranged Near com stats de Blaster), Energy Net (grapple Near) e Kinetic Grapple Cable (move 1 Range category ou captura item solto).

abilities.name: Scout Drone
abilities.effect: Drone opera em Range Far para explorar dutos, rastrear calor/movimento ou projetar holograma; inimigos na Zone fazem Challenging Mind Test ou desperdiçam o próximo ataque no holograma.

abilities.name: System Infiltration
abilities.effect: Em Near, faz Mind Test com Advantage contra Tension do dispositivo para abrir portas, loop de câmeras, desativar tripwires ou ativar sprinklers.

aptitudes.name: Phytokinesis
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Entangling Roots
abilities.effect: Alvo Near faz Challenging Agility Test ou fica Immobilized.

abilities.name: Irritant Puff
abilities.effect: Alvo Close faz Resistance Test contra Spirit do usuário ou fica Shaken.

abilities.name: Plant Whispers
abilities.effect: Lê traços químicos em plantas para rastrear alvos; faz uma pergunta ao GM sobre o ambiente e recebe resposta verdadeira.

aptitudes.name: Poly-Limb Musculature
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Interposing Arm Guard
abilities.effect: Active Block contra melee strike; adiciona Grade +2 à Defense em vez de Resistance.

abilities.name: Multi-Grip Advantage
abilities.effect: Advantage em Force e Agility Tests para grapple, escalar, evitar ser desarmado ou segurar portas pesadas.

abilities.name: Synchronized Flurry
abilities.effect: Ataca até dois alvos Close com membros diferentes; faz uma attack roll e causa dano Physical base em cada alvo atingido.

aptitudes.name: Pyrokinesis
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Cauterize Wound
abilities.effect: Toca aliado Bleeding em Close e remove Bleeding; uma vez por Episode também pode remover uma Condition do aliado.

abilities.name: Plasma Stream
abilities.effect: Ranged Attack em Near; em acerto causa Fire damage igual a Tier Die + Damage Attribute e incendeia terreno inflamável atingido.

abilities.name: Thermal Retaliation
abilities.effect: Quando ataque físico melee acerta, atacante recebe Fire damage igual ao Grade.

aptitudes.name: Self-Sustenance
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Metabolic Purge
abilities.effect: Remove Poisoned ou Bleeding.

abilities.name: Sealed Respiration
abilities.effect: Imunidade a afogamento, fumaça, ar rarefeito e gases tóxicos, incluindo armas químicas e esporos.

aptitudes.name: Sphere Form
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Momentum Cushion
abilities.effect: Enquanto enrolado em Sphere Form, não recebe dano de queda, independentemente da altura ou superfície de impacto.

abilities.name: Shell Deflection
abilities.effect: Enquanto já estiver enrolado, adiciona Grade +1 Defense contra ranged fire.

abilities.name: Tuck & Roll
abilities.effect: Enrola-se; permanece assim por múltiplos Turns e desenrola como Free Action. Enquanto enrolado, recebe +2 DR contra Physical strikes e move 2 Range categories por Move Action.

aptitudes.name: Toxicity
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Adhesive Slime Puddle
abilities.effect: Espalha lodo em Zone adjacente, tornando-a Difficult Terrain por 1 round para aliados e inimigos.

abilities.name: Caustic Spit
abilities.effect: Ranged Attack em Near; causa Acid damage igual a Tier Die + Spirit; alvo faz Opposed Resistance Test contra Spirit ou fica Corroded por 1 round.

abilities.name: Venomous Reaction
abilities.effect: Quem acerta o personagem com Close melee strike sofre 2 Acid ou Poison damage; ativa em todo melee hit, inclusive ataques múltiplos.

aptitudes.name: Vocal Resonators
aptitudes.grade1EnergyRule: Grade 1 costs 1 Energy when used, unless the ability is Passive (0 Energy), following the general Grade/Energy rule.

abilities.name: Acoustic Pulse
abilities.effect: Ranged Attack em Near com onda vibratória; causa Energy damage igual a Tier Die + Spirit; Critical Hit empurra alvo 1 Range category.

abilities.name: Echolocation Sweep
abilities.effect: Uma vez por Round, identifica todos os alvos escondidos, invisíveis ou phased que estejam tocando superfície sólida na Location.

abilities.name: Vibrational Deflection
abilities.effect: Contra projéteis frágeis de vidro, cristal ou similar, adiciona +3 Defense.
